accepted.title: Generalized exact-overlaps formula in arbitrary dimension
accepted.text: Let d≥1 and μ=Σᵢpᵢδ_gᵢ be a finitely supported probability on similarities gᵢ(x)=ρᵢUᵢx+bᵢ of ℝᵈ, with 0<ρᵢ<1 and orthogonal Uᵢ. Assume the group generated by the Uᵢ has no invariant linear subspaces except0 andℝᵈ, and the gᵢ have no common fixed point. Let ν=Σᵢpᵢ(gᵢ)_*ν be the unique stationary probability, χ=Σᵢpᵢlogρᵢ, and h=lim_{n→∞}H(μ^{*n})/n, where H is Shannon entropy using natural logarithms and coincident products are combined. Must dimν=min{d,h/|χ|}? Here dimν is the almost-sure limit logν(B_r(x))/log r as r↓0.
accepted.subject: Probability & Fractal Geometry
accepted.scope_review: Contracting in this introductory conjecture means every support map contracts (physical17), not merely average negative Lyapunov exponent. Arbitrary exact overlaps are allowed and h is random-walk entropy, not single-step Shannon entropy. The full all-dimensional target is retained with the dimension-one partial closure explicitly recorded.
accepted.literature_finding: Kittle–Kogler2610.10511v1, submitted7October2026, states and proves the generalized exact-overlaps formula in dimensionone. The all-dimensional conjecture is not thereby closed; held thesis gives higher-dimensional exponential-separation special case. Fresh primary searches found no unrestricted higher-dimensional theorem.
